Subject: Packaging options for hybrid seat + throughput

Kimberly —

Thanks again for yesterday's demo. A few follow-ups from our side as we model costs for a pilot: BrightMed wants a combo of reserved seats (for synchronous clinician-facing queries) plus a throughput pool for batch jobs. Key asks: can we get a temporary migration credit to offset overlap while we move traffic, what downgrade path exists if usage drops after the pilot, and which features are only available at the higher tier (so we can decide bundles)?

Can you share a short matrix showing: 1) seat counts vs burst/throughput buckets, 2) which features are gated by tier (e.g., canary rollouts, extended trace retention, private model pinning), and 3) an illustrative price/credit example for a 3-month pilot? Procurement will need that for an internal business case.

Appreciate a single-page summary + a follow-up call.

—Evan

Subject: Re: Packaging options for hybrid seat + throughput

Hi Evan —

Thanks — happy to put that together. High level answers up front so procurement has context before the deck:

- Migration credit: we can offer a one-time migration credit equal to 25% of the first-month committed spend for pilots signed by end of September; applies to first invoice and is visible as a line-item credit.
- Downgrade path: customers can reduce seat commitments at the next monthly billing cycle with a 30-day notice; for reserved GPU throughput buckets we support step-downs with prorated refunds but require 45 days for rebalancing capacity (we document the exact dates in the SOW).
- Feature gating: canary rollouts + rollout policies are available on all tiers; extended trace retention (90 days) and private model pinning are part of the Enterprise bundle. We can temporarily enable private pinning for pilots under NDA — would need a short ephemeral agreement.

I'll attach a one-pager with: seat/throughput matrix, feature map by bundle, and two illustrative pilot scenarios (small pilot and pilot+scale). Neha, could you add the pricing numbers and an example invoice line so Evan has procurement-ready detail?

If acceptable, I'll schedule a 30-minute call Wednesday to walk through the matrix and confirm the mutual action plan.

Best,
Kimberly Park

Kimberly / Aditya —

Draft pricing sketch for BrightMed pilot (numbers illustrative, will be in formal proposal):

- Option A (Pilot - small): 10 reserved seats + 1 throughput bucket (100k tokens/day)
  - List: $12,000/month
  - Proposed pilot discount: 20% for first 3 months
  - Migration credit: one-time credit = 25% of first month = $3,000

- Option B (Pilot + scale): 25 reserved seats + 2 throughput buckets (300k tokens/day)
  - List: $30,000/month
  - Proposed pilot discount: 25% for first 3 months
  - Migration credit: one-time credit = 25% of first month = $7,500

Notes / asks for approval:
- Approve temporary enabling of private model pinning for 3 months under our standard pilot NDA (revenue impact: operational overhead only).
- Approve migration credit structure above (one-time, applied to first invoice).
- Approve standard downgrade terms (30-day notice for seats, 45 days for throughput buckets) — I flagged the SRE ops team so they are aware of the rebalancing window.

If Aditya signs off, Kimberly can share the one-pager + attached proposal PDF. I also included a short example invoice snippet in the attached workbook (redwood_feature_matrix_q3.xlsx).

Evan —

Attached is the one-page matrix and formal pilot proposal (BrightMed_Proposal_Q3_2027.pdf). Quick summary:

- We recommend Option B (Pilot + scale) if you expect clinician traffic to ramp quickly; Option A reduces up-front spend and preserves flexibility.
- Offerings included: rollout policies, live trace sampling (30 days), and optional private model pinning for the pilot under NDA (no additional product fee).
- Financial: 25% one-time migration credit applied to first invoice + pilot discount for months 1–3 (25% for Option B, 20% for Option A). Both options allow step-downs per terms noted earlier.

Next steps I propose:
1) Sign pilot SOW and NDA by end of week to lock migration credit.
2) Kickoff meeting the following Monday (Ops + SRE + Security).
3) 30-day check-in to evaluate seat utilization and decide on scale/downgrade.

Would you like me to route the SOW for e-signature after procurement confirms billing contact? Happy to hop on a 20-minute call today if there are any redlines.

Thanks — looking forward to working with BrightMed on this pilot.

Attachments: BrightMed_Proposal_Q3_2027.pdf, redwood_feature_matrix_q3.xlsx

—Kimberly
